title: Prepare observable future laws without assuming microscopic convergence
statement: For the declared operation-then-observation programs, joint record TV is at most min(1,sqrt(K_joint^2-1)[b_m/2+eta_service]). The complete retained old record remains in the comparison. If an initial fresh state label is read, pay an additional sqrt(k) branching factor or count it as an identity-kernel observation stage. Actual adjoint access and the reference L2 geometry remain required.
